name: powerbi-desktop
description: Fully analyze and diagnose an open Power BI Desktop file: one-call ranked audit (audit_dashboard), the live data model (DAX, relationships, Power Query M with step dependencies), RLS, VertiPaq size, report layout/filters/hidden pages, and deep diagnosis for SQL Server, SharePoint and SharePoint/OneDrive sources -- connection classification, embedded-SQL linting, query-folding analysis, SharePoint anti-patterns, refresh dependencies, mashup trace logs, relationship integrity, table data-quality profiling, and dashboard comparison. Also reviews and edits COPIES of .pbix .pbit .pbip .pbir .pbids .rdl .tmdl files, one approved change at a time, with a one-time approval code, backup, verification and rollback. Bundles skills guiding Claude through analysis and editing.
